an5.34:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati mahāvane kūṭāgārasālāyaṃ.
an5.34:1.2: athakho sīho senāpati yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi ekamantaṃ nisinno kho sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.34:1.3: sakkā nu kho bhante sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ paññāpetunti.
an5.34:2.2: dāyako sīha dānapati bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo
an5.34:2.3: yaṃpi sīha dāyako dānapati bahuno janassa piyo hoti manāpo idaṃpi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:3.1: puna caparaṃ sīha dāyakaṃ dānapatiṃ santo sappurisā bhajanti
an5.34:3.2: yaṃpi sīha dāyakaṃ dānapatiṃ santo sappurisā bhajanti idaṃpi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:4.1: puna caparaṃ sīha dāyakassa dānapatino kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati
an5.34:4.2: yaṃpi sīha dāyakassa dānapatino kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggacchati idaṃpi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:5.1: puna caparaṃ sīha dāyako dānapati yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto
an5.34:5.2: yaṃpi sīha dāyako dānapati yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamati yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ visārado upasaṅkamati amaṅkubhūto idaṃpi sandiṭṭhikaṃ dānaphalaṃ.
an5.34:6.1: puna caparaṃ sīha dāyako dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
an5.34:6.2: yaṃpi sīha dāyako dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati idaṃpi samparāyikaṃ dānaphalanti.
an5.34:7.1: evaṃ vutte sīho senāpati bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
an5.34:7.2: yānīmāni bhante bhagavatā cattāri sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni akkhātāni nāhaṃ ettha bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi ahaṃpetāni jānāmi
an5.34:7.3: ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati bahuno janassa piyo manāpo
an5.34:7.4: ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati maṃ santo sappurisā bhajanti
an5.34:7.5: ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati mayhaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato sīho senāpati dāyako kārako saṃghupaṭṭhākoti
an5.34:7.6: ahaṃ bhante dāyako dānapati yaññadeva parisaṃ upasaṅkamāmi yadi khattiyaparisaṃ yadi brāhmaṇaparisaṃ yadi gahapatiparisaṃ yadi samaṇaparisaṃ visārado upasaṅkamāmi amaṅkubhūto.
an5.34:7.7: yānīmāni bhante bhagavatā cattāri sandiṭṭhikāni dānaphalāni akkhātāni nāhaṃ ettha bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmi ahaṃpetāni jānāmi.
an5.34:7.8: yañca kho maṃ bhante bhagavā evamāha
an5.34:7.9: dāyako sīha dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatīti etāhaṃ na jānāmi ettha ca panāhaṃ bhagavato saddhāya gacchāmīti.
an5.34:7.11: dāyako sīha dānapati kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjatīti.
an5.34:8.1: dadaṃ piyo hoti bhajanti naṃ bahū
